Three signals that brands are betting on presence

A club filmed for the headset, the film volume went commercial, and the audience turned on synthetic ads. All three reward something real.

01A football giant shot a film for the headsetField notes 02The film volume became a brand toolIn the lab 03The audience started punishing AI adsCraft
01 Field notes

A football giant shot a film for the headset

Apple and Real Madrid teamed on an immersive documentary filmed during the 2025 to 2026 Champions League, with more than 30 Blackmagic immersive cameras capturing the match up close. It arrives in 2026 as premium content shot specifically for spatial viewing.

See the shift ›
02
In the lab

The film volume became a brand tool

The real time virtual production stack that shot The Mandalorian, Unreal and an LED volume, matured into a commercial tool. In 2026 agencies and brands are booking the volume to shoot ten locations in a day without leaving the stage.

See the stack ›
03 Craft

The audience started punishing AI ads

A June 2026 Harris Poll found 78 percent of consumers say AI makes ads feel less authentic and 63 percent are less likely to buy from a brand that runs one. The antidote to a feed full of synthetic content is something physical, in the room, that a model cannot flood.
